findings.item: Q10 (a failure gives an error of the kit and a clean state); AP-014: the sibling branch of F3
findings.what: The branch still reads state.exit without a guard. A child that emits close with no exit - possible only through deps.spawn (with Node's spawn, error comes before close on a failed spawn and exit before close otherwise) - makes startStand throw a raw TypeError ('Cannot read properties of null (reading 'signal')') and skip abortStart, so the marker stays and, with a pid, the group stays registered until the exit handler (trial 12: pid undefined -> 1 marker left; pid 999999 -> 1 group registered and 2 markers). No effect with a real child; it can trip a test of TEST-DESIGNER that injects a fake child (issue I3).
findings.fix: Build STAND_START_EXITED from 'state.exit ?? { code: null, signal: null }' (or let exitInfoOf accept null), so this branch too ends with an error of the kit and abortStart.

findings.item: Q7 (what reaches the child) - precision of the README statement; the side point of the pass-1 F1, left by step 04b (its I5)
findings.place: tools/README.md:844 ('... and what the spec gives, nothing else (no HOME unless the spec gives it; ...)')
findings.what: Two names reach the child that are neither in the base list nor given by the spec: macOS adds __CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING to every process, and Node itself copies NODE_V8_COVERAGE from the parent when it is set (trial 1 A on the current code: LANG, LC_ALL, NODE_V8_COVERAGE, PATH, TEMP, TMP, TMPDIR, TZ, __CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING). Neither holds a secret (one is set by the system for every process, the other exists only when the developer turned coverage on), so the sentence is imprecise, not a leak.
findings.fix: Add a clause such as '(the platform may add its own: __CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING on macOS, and NODE_V8_COVERAGE when the spec process has it)' without removing any existing word.

issues.text: For ORCH, on O15 (true as written): one door it does not name - a folder can reach the server through its arguments as well as through env: main.js of Pixel Office takes --dir <absolute path>, and with --dir and no SAI_PIXEL_OFFICE_DIR or HOME it still resolves the hook's folder from the home folder (it only warns). The checked pairs 'variable -> folder' of O15 do not cover an argument, so the design of REQ-106 should also check or forbid folder arguments; and the hook, which the spec runs itself, resolves its folder from its own environment (hook.js:86), so the spec gives the hook the same folder.

On O16 (true as written): F4 remains in stand.js (199, 206 and 359-365 unchanged by 04b; trial 5 D and E reproduce it on the current code) and belongs to O16's defect with cleanup.js and browser.js. The words 'the same two shapes in the new stand.js are fixed in this run' mean the two shapes of REVIEWER's I2 (the pipes read before the error listener, an error attached to itself), both verified fixed (trial 11), not F4.

For TEST-DESIGNER through ORCH: (a) a fake child given through deps.spawn must emit exit before close, or error before close, as Node does; a fake that emits close alone meets F5 (a TypeError, trial 12); (b) the pipeless case of L1 can be tested with a deps.spawn fake that emits error and then close on the next tick (trial 11 b), no descriptor limit needed; a real EMFILE needs the kit's handlers installed before the descriptor table is filled, otherwise Node itself aborts in SignalWrap (exit 134); (c) E2S-05 and NODE_V8_COVERAGE (I3 of step 03) still hold.

For REVIEWER (not security items): (a) I3 of step 04b judged - a timeout of 0 is refused correctly (USAGE, 0 spawns), only the words '... a whole number of milliseconds' are imprecise; (b) when the body error cannot take cleanupError (frozen, sealed, a read-only property, a Proxy that refuses, a non-object), a failure of stop() - even CLEANUP_FAILED, a group alive after SIGKILL - is reported nowhere; before 04b this was so for non-objects, and for a frozen error pass 1 lost the body error instead; informational; (c) timeouts above 2147483647 ms still become a 1 ms timer (fail fast, no hang), I4 (a) of step 03.

Facts of the task checked: the tag = HEAD = 4f41032; step 04b changed only stand.js and tools/README.md (the diff against the pass-1 copies holds only the lines it lists), index.js and fake-stand.js have the pass-1 hashes, the nine other kit files equal the tag, tools/src is unchanged; decisions/0109 holds O13-O16; REVIEWER's pass-1 FAIL (M1 = F3, L1-L4) was read. The task named no expected verdict (AP-018). REVIEWER's pass 2 (step 04d) ran in parallel and its handoff changed during this check, as expected; no other file changed.

Pass-1 issues after 04b: I4 (b) of step 03 (a frozen body error replaced by a TypeError) is fixed (t10: 'the body error'); I4 (a) (timeouts above 2^31-1 ms) unchanged and harmless; I5 (bidi characters pass safeText) and I6 (the spec reporter prints the cause of STAND_START_FAILED) concern shared kit code and are unchanged, outside this run.
